name: glg-questionnaire
description: Triages GLG expert-network project invitations in Gmail and fills, reviews and submits the screening questionnaire or follow-up questions in the member's own browser, using only answers the member authored. Never invents an answer, never submits without an explicit go.

interface.shortDescription: Fill GLG screening questionnaires from your own answers
interface.longDescription: Finds GLG project invitations and follow-up questions in Gmail, shows a one-table triage with rate, client type, link expiry and fit, then opens the questionnaire in your signed-in browser and fills it from an answer bank seeded from your past GLG confirmations plus your profile. Every row on the answer sheet names its source; rows with no source are yours to fill. Submission, acceptance and declines happen only after you confirm the sheet. Employer, conflict and recording questions always go to you.
defaultPrompt: What GLG projects are waiting for me?
Fill the GLG questionnaire for the observability project
